verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents tool use as a first-class API capability, with a maintained function-calling guide and runnable OpenAI-format examples, and it ships an agent-harness developer preview. However, a hands-on user report concretely contradicts the "faithful" claim, describing excessive duplicated function calls and hallucinated names/params; that report concerns the older DS3 model, so it may not reflect current versions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parallel and multi-step tool calls, typed/strict schema enforcement, and independent corroboration that tool calling is reliable on current models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — typed tool definitions, parallel and multi-step calls — documented well enough to run an agent loop on this model

citations.quote: A maintained function-calling guide with runnable OpenAI-format examples (stream or non-stream) — tool use is a documented first-class capability of the API.
DeepSeek Harness is now in developer preview for agent harness developers worldwide.
